reason: The fix is minimatch 11.0.1, a major version; @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree (through eslint-config-next) declares minimatch ^10.2.2, so an override would break its declared range. The globparts amplification needs an attacker-controlled glob; minimatch 10.2.6 reaches apps/web only through the lint toolchain, which matches the repository's own config patterns, and the site never builds a glob from user input. Revisit when typescript-estree accepts minimatch 11 or the deadline passes.
